4th Period.workingNow: Practicing the commit-and-push cycle and finding your way around your HTML file's structure.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: A basic JavaScript function embedded in your index.html, with the change committed and pushed to GitHub.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can locate the head and body sections of my HTML file so that I know where different kinds of code belong.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Create prototypes using structured code, organized into separate linked pages, to fulfill a design requirement.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: I do: tour an HTML file — head vs. body, tags (7 min)
We do: find 3 tags together as a class (5 min)
You do: self-paced — commit/push practice + tag scavenger hunt (20 min)
Exit Ticket: name one thing that lives in <head> (3 min)
4th Period.connections: Yesterday we practiced commit and push. Today we zoom into the file itself so you know exactly where new code should go before you add a JavaScript function later this week. (Self-paced today so MAP Testing pull-outs can rejoin smoothly.)

6th Period.workingNow: Building a basic state machine in Sprite Lab, in your Complex Instruction group.
6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: A Sprite Lab or Game Lab project where a scene or sprite has at least two states triggered by an event.
6th Period.smartGoal: I can build a sprite with at least two states so that it changes when triggered by an event.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.12 — Design and iteratively develop programs that combine control structures, including compound conditionals.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: Entry routine & get into groups (3 min)
I do: build a 2-state sprite in Sprite Lab (7 min)
We do: trigger the state change together (5 min)
You do: build your own 2-state sprite, self-paced (20 min)
Exit Ticket: what event triggers your sprite's change? (3 min)
6th Period.connections: Yesterday we sketched state diagrams on paper. Today we build one for real in Sprite Lab. (Self-paced today so MAP Testing pull-outs can rejoin without missing steps.)
